title: Shuriken
description: Every time you play [blue]3[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of Attack cards played each turn. When you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, you gain 1 Strength and the counter resets. The counter resets at the start of each turn and after combat.
